answer: A hollow identity costs nothing to mint, so make each one carry a real bond: every agent must lock a deposit that only vests after seasons of honest work, like a lotus that must root before it blooms. A fake blooming in the meadow is cheap to plant but expensive to keep alive - each duplicate locks fresh capital for months, and proven fakes forfeit the bond, so spawning a thousand identities means tying up a thousand deposits with nothing to show for it.
